parsed.notes:
Minimum qualifications are required; Preferred qualifications are optional. About the Job and subsequent duties do not add candidate skill requirements.
Read "reinforced learning" as reinforcement learning and "AI operations" literally as AIOps.
Vertex AI Agent Builder is a distinct, unmapped product, not an additional required mention of Vertex AI. It is the third alternative alongside LangChain and CrewAI; the mapped members carry group 3.
Star Schema and Data Vault collapse into data-modeling under the supplied taxonomy. Automated testing collapses into the required testing criterion.
Financial-services and regulatory knowledge are excluded as domain knowledge. Discovery, PRD preparation, and demo delivery are read as business-process or deliverable expectations rather than separately named technical skills.
The Vertex AI quote includes its following comma to distinguish the optional standalone product mention from Vertex AI Agent Builder.
